```{r load-pkg, message = FALSE, eval = FALSE}

library(tidyverse)

```

## Background and target

Researchers examined whether a six-week mindfulness program reduced perceived stress. Forty adults were assigned to either a mindfulness intervention or a waitlist control group. Participants completed a perceived-stress measure at baseline and at Weeks 2, 4, and 6. Scores can range from 0 to 100, with higher scores indicating greater stress.

Your goal is to generate (*exactly!*) the following graph. All features of the graph need to be *exactly the same* as the image below to receive full credit!

Hint 1: The cleaned data that you summarize to create the graph should have 139 rows.

Hint 2: The y axis is a _mean_ stress score.

![](mindfulness_stress_goal.png)

## Import and inspect the data

```{r import-data, eval = FALSE}

stress_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/mindfulness_stress_messy.csv",
  na = c("", "NA", "missing", "-99")
)

glimpse(stress_raw)
nrow(stress_raw)

stress_raw %>% count(condition)
stress_raw %>% count(assessment)
stress_raw %>% count(use_data)

```

## Clean and recode the data

```{r clean-data, eval = FALSE}

stress_clean <- stress_raw %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = str_to_upper(participant_id),
    age_years = parse_number(age),
    stress_score = parse_number(stress_rating),

    condition = str_to_lower(condition),
    condition = str_replace_all(condition, " ", "_"),
    condition = case_when(
      condition %in% c(
        "mindfulness",
        "mindfulness_group",
        "mbsr"
      ) ~ "Mindfulness",
      condition %in% c(
        "control",
        "waitlist",
        "control_group"
      ) ~ "Control",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    assessment = str_to_lower(assessment),
    assessment = str_replace_all(assessment, " ", ""),
    week = case_when(
      assessment %in% c("baseline", "week0", "wk0") ~ 0,
      assessment %in% c("week2", "wk2", "2weeks") ~ 2,
      assessment %in% c("week4", "wk4", "4weeks") ~ 4,
      assessment %in% c("week6", "wk6", "6weeks") ~ 6,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    use_data = str_to_lower(use_data),
    included = use_data %in% c("include", "yes", "keep")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    included == TRUE,
    !is.na(condition),
    !is.na(week),
    !is.na(stress_score),
    between(stress_score, 0, 100)
  ) %>%
  select(
    participant_id,
    age_years,
    condition,
    week,
    stress_score
  )

```

## Check the cleaned data

```{r check-cleaning, eval = FALSE}

nrow(stress_clean) # 139

stress_clean %>% count(condition, week)

stress_clean %>%
  summarize(
    missing_condition = sum(is.na(condition)),
    missing_week = sum(is.na(week)),
    missing_stress = sum(is.na(stress_score)),
    minimum_stress = min(stress_score),
    maximum_stress = max(stress_score)
  )

```

## Create the summary table

```{r summarize-data, eval = FALSE}

stress_summary <- stress_clean %>%
  group_by(condition, week) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean_stress = mean(stress_score),
    sd_stress = sd(stress_score),
    se_stress = sd_stress / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stress_summary %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(mean_stress, sd_stress, se_stress),
      ~ round(.x, 2)
    )
  )

```

Expected group means, rounded to two decimal places:

| Condition | Week 0 | Week 2 | Week 4 | Week 6 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mindfulness | 63.75 | 58.01 | 51.84 | 45.19 |
| Control | 64.48 | 63.39 | 62.39 | 60.83 |

## Create the target line graph

```{r target-line-graph, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6, eval = FALSE}

ggplot(
  stress_summary,
  aes(
    x = week,
    y = mean_stress,
    color = condition,
    group = condition
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(40, 50, 60, 70)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Mindfulness" = "blue",
      "Control" = "red"
    ),
    breaks = c("Mindfulness", "Control")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Perceived stress across the intervention",
    x = "Assessment week",
    y = "Mean perceived stress score",
    color = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("img/mindfulness_stress_goal.png", height = 4, width = 8)

```
